highlights: UGREEN 8K Micro HDMI to HDMI Cable, 2.1 Aluminum Shell Braided 48Gbps Ultra High Speed - 2M
Special FeatureBraided, Data Transfer, High Speed

8K@60Hz Micro HDMI to HDMI Cable: UGREEN Micro HDMI cable supports 8K@60Hz, 4K@240Hz, and 4K@144Hz Full HD resolution. It can help you to stream audio and video from a camera, tablet or laptop through the Micro HDMI Port to Your HDTV or projector with an HDMI port. NOTE: Please pay attention to the interface of your device, micro HDMI port NOT mini HDMI or micro USB

High Speed & Stable Transmission: 48Gbps transmission speed and Audio Return Channel offers uncompressed multichannel digital audio, high-speed transmission without signal loss. 32AWG tinned copper conductors provide this micro HDMI cord with superior conductivity. Triple shieldings effectively protect against EMI interference, ensuring more stable signal transmission. With gold-plated connectors, this high-speed 2.1 micro HDMI adapter offers you a longer lifespan

Upgrade Material to More Durable: Nylon braided wire, touch upgraded, more resistant to wear and tear, no fear of pet pulling and can withstand 25,000+ flex times. Plus aluminum shell, more heat dissipation and corrosion resistance, making our wire more durable

Bi-Directional & Support Dynamic HDR: This 8K HDMI to micro HDMI cable supports two-way transmission. It also supports Dynamic HDR/3D, HDR, Dolby Atmos, and eARC which deliver superb images and clear thrilling surround sound for a cinematic video feast

Wide Compatibility: Compatible with Raspberry Pi 5, Raspberry Pi 4, Raspberry Pi 500, GoPro Hero 7 Black, Samsung G8 OLED, G9 OLED, Hero 6 Hero5, Hero 4 Silver, Hero 3 White, Hero3+, Go Pro Hero 2018, Portable Monitor, Retroid Pocket 3+/3, camera, Nikon b500, EOS M50, IdeaPad Miix 300 Tablet, ThinkPad 10 8, Yoga 2 Pro 3 ultrabook, Yoga 700 710, 710s, video capture card. Note: This 2.1 Micro HDMI cable can not fit for those phones or tablets with a Micro USB port
